market.title: Stephen Curry Leaves the Warriors
resolutionNote: The live odds below are Kalshi-only, tracking the 'stays with Golden State' side directly. Polymarket has a genuinely matching market, but it's framed as the inverse binary - "Does Stephen Curry leave the Warriors?" - so its own site currently shows about 6% Yes (leaves), the mirror of Kalshi's roughly 83% (stays). Both numbers point the same direction; they're just quoted from opposite sides of the same question, so they aren't shown side-by-side in one widget here.
Kalshi's own wording: "If Steph Curry's next team is Stays with Golden State or Retires before Oct 21, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes."
One real gap between the platforms: Kalshi's cutoff is Oct 21, 2026, while Polymarket's is Oct 22, 2026, 11:59 PM ET.

text: The conversation regarding a Steph Curry exit from the Warriors heated up after LeBron James turned down a move to the team in favor of the 76ers in July.

Some bettors believe Curry may be looking for the door due to the lack of a big-name signing at Golden State, with the team failing to seal the deal with LeBron, Giannis Antetokounmpo, Jaylen Brown, and Anthony Davis.
However, Curry has repeatedly claimed that he wants to retire with the team that drafted him (Golden State) and is eligible to negotiate a contract extension in August this year.
NBA insider Brett Siegel believes Curry's loyalty to the Warriors makes a move 'impossible,' and this is reflected in the price, which has Curry at 80%+ to stay.
